items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: this old guitar player that used to play with Art Tatum

ctx.x: I don’t know it was just one of those college things you know, your buddy’s on TV playing with this old guitar player that used to play with Art Tatum. I don’t know, they thought it was funny. I probably did look pretty funny.
And you moved to the Boston area and got re-hooked-up with Chris Flory?
